```python
import polars as pl
import narwhals as nw

# Scan the parquet file lazily with polars backend
lazy_df = pl.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Wrap with narwhals
df = nw.from_native(lazy_df)

# Build and materialize the lazy pipeline
result = (
    df
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
    .collect()
)

print(result)
```
